plugins.description: ultra: best-of-N trajectories with a reasoned verifier and guided repair. /ultra runs N isolated attempts in parallel, picks the strongest with a skeptical verifier, then runs one guided repair pass that is kept only if it is better.

description: ultra: best-of-N with a reasoned same-model verifier and guided repair, as a native /ultra command.
